title: Nice Shot (Wii Sports)
blurb: Chipper, immediate and entirely unearned. It may be the most sincere compliment in gaming history, offered by a man who cannot see what you actually did. Wii Sports golf hands out praise generously, and the nostalgia runs deep for anyone whose family spent 2007 swinging a remote at a television. The meme value is all in ironic deployment: terrible decisions executed confidently, parallel parking attempts requiring four goes, any shot that was demonstrably not nice. The announcer believes in you even when he really should not.
origin: The announcer compliment from Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006).
